subject: Zukunft von Emir in der U12 — wir sind unsicher

triage.summary: Undecided father (Mevlüt Yilmaz) asks whether his U12 son Emir can pause a season, move to a team with fewer training days, or should cancel at season end — and what that would mean for the paid contribution — so an exit/fee decision must go to a human.
triage.proposed_action: Route to a human (board/youth lead) — no automatic exit processing. Present the family's options for personal advice: temporary pause/leave of absence, internal transfer to a lower-training-frequency team, and cancellation-at-season-end terms including how the already paid contribution is handled (refund policy). Accept the offered phone call. Mixed mail classified as cancellation because exit is floated, with fee/refund sub-question.

details.fee_question: asks what happens to the already paid contribution if they cancel
options_considered: pause for one season without leaving
transfer to a team with fewer training days
details.reason: father's job in transition since April, commuting to Stuttgart 3x/week; Emir often arrives home at 18:30 exhausted; said twice that football is no longer fun, but father attributes this to the long days (child still follows the club on weekends)
details.squad_move_within_club: switch to a team with fewer training days also floated (not an exit by itself)

policy_reason: Policy: intent 'cancellation' requires human decision (mitten in der Saison — Trainerplanung und Erstattung)
